# Andreas Colucci

> Andreas Colucci is an event operations consultant specializing in large-scale, high-pressure events such as music festivals and stadium shows. Over more than 10 years he has delivered 300+ events across 20+ countries, leading on-site operations, cashless payment systems, access control, and real-time problem solving.

## Key facts
- Role: Event Operations Consultant
- Experience: 10+ years, 300+ events, 20+ countries
- Scale: single events of 110,000+ attendees
- Specialties: cashless payment systems, access control, RFID technology, ticketing, crowd flow, real-time operations
- Education: BBA, IE University (Madrid)
- Languages: English, Italian, Spanish
- Contact: hello@andreascolucci.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreascolucci/

## Selected events
- Sónar (Barcelona) — music festival
- MotoGP — motorsport
- Campovolo — large-scale concert
- Kappa FuturFestival (Turin) — music festival
- Monegros Desert Festival — music festival
- elrow — electronic music events
- Stadio Olimpico — stadium events
